newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile industrial output up 2.6 pct in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Chile industrial output up 2.6 pct in 1996.

text.p: Chilean industrial production in December grew 4.4 percent from a year earlier, bringing the increase in output to 2.6 percent for the full year, the trade group Socidad de Fomento Fabril (Sofofa) said Thursday.
Industrial sales grew 7.6 percent last month from the month in 1995, bringing the sales increase for the full year to three percent, Sofofa said.
Areas with greatest production last year included glass manufacture, up 23 percent, iron and steel industries, up 15 percent, and non-metallic mineral production, up 12 percent.
Production declines were seen in leatherware (except shoes), down eight percent, leather shoes, down seven percent, and domestic electrical products, down 5.6 percent.
